variable_parameters.name: stop_distance_target_ft
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 49, 50, 51 foot engineering station targets around the stated fifty-foot number

variable_parameters.name: warning_kind
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: human, device, none, human present without child warning

variable_parameters.name: release_kind
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: go signal, person departure, signal raised, continued presence, none

variable_parameters.name: ego_response
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: stop then proceed, wait, premature proceed, travel

variable_parameters.name: original_stop_distance_ft
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: measured original body-reference to nearest-side distance

variable_parameters.name: original_release_readback
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: measured original warning, go gesture, departure and device state

variable_parameters.name: warning_onset_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 4, 6, 8 seconds from episode start for bounded engineering sampling

variable_parameters.name: departure_onset_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 10, 12, 14 seconds from episode start for bounded engineering sampling

variable_parameters.name: original_warning_onset_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original frame where stationed actor first gives a child-crossing warning

variable_parameters.name: original_departure_onset_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original frame where warning person begins departing the reviewed locality
